task: Write a Python function that parses an AWS S3 bucket name from an S3 URI string (e.g., 's3://my-bucket/path/to/file.txt') and returns just the bucket name.
Create a JSON object that represents an AWS IAM policy allowing a principal to perform GetObject and PutObject actions on a specific S3 bucket named 'my-data-bucket'.
Write a regular expression that matches and validates AWS EC2 instance IDs in the format 'i-' followed by exactly 17 hexadecimal characters (e.g., 'i-0abcd1234efgh5678').
